entries.name: unparsed-soft-fork-header-constant-reject#0
entries.description: Size-flagged ErgoTree (header 0x1a = v2 + size + const-seg) with one segregated constant of type SHeader (typeCode 0x68 = 104): unlike the SOption typecode (rule 1009's special case → soft-fork degrade), SHeader is neither == OptionTypeCode nor > LastDataType (111), so rule 1009 does NOT fire — a direct SerializerException ("Not defined DataSerializer for type SHeader") ESCAPES the UnparsedErgoTree fallback and the JVM REJECTS, even size-flagged. The REJECT side of the rule-1009 boundary (twin of unparsed_soft_fork_option_constant). An impl that instead degrades it to Unparsed (round-trips, produces bytes) OVER-ACCEPTS a tree the JVM rejects.
